fluff.overview: The Word of Blake's Nuclear, Biological, and Chemical Special Weapons Teams were the standard force for handling combat zones contaminated by weapons of mass destruction. Trained and equipped for operations in toxic environments, these mechanized assault platoons appeared during or immediately after Word of Blake strikes involving nuclear or chemical weapons, scouring irradiated ground for survivors and taking prisoners. Their environment suits provide protection against NBC hazards, while their wheeled mechanized transport carries decontamination gear alongside the platoon's Mauser 1200 LSS laser rifles and man-portable plasma rifles. NBC teams also operated in the aftermath of conventional raids, processing battlefields that conventional troops could not safely enter. Their willingness to work in lethal conditions made them a grim but essential component of the Word's military operations during the Jihad.
